title: Haggis and Dumpling Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew from Scotland, featuring haggis, dumplings, and a rich broth.

ingredients.name: Haggis
ingredients.notes: Available in most supermarkets or specialty stores

instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
2. Add the chopped onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for another 5 minutes.
4. Add the haggis and cook until heated through.
5. Pour in the beer and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
7. Meanwhile, prepare the dumplings according to package instructions.
8. Add the dumplings to the stew and cook for another 10 minutes.
